summary: The functor is assembled almost entirely by `change`/`unfold` steps that re-derive, by definitional equality, facts Mathlib already states as simp lemmas (`CommHopfAlgCat.hom_id`/`hom_comp`, `Rep.hom_ofHom`, `Rep.hom_id`, `Representation.ofMulDistribMulAction_apply_apply`, `ObjectProperty.ι_obj_lift_obj`); two of these carry no comment at all. The `IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms` instance additionally hand-rolls `Representation.equivOfIso` and disambiguates a `Module ℤ` diamond by poking the raw `Rep` field `hV2`.
